<module id="asyn_fifo">
    <description>An asynchronous FIFO, where the FIFO bit width and depth are configurable parameters.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="wclk">Write clock signal used for synchronous write operations.</input>
        <input id="rclk">Read clock signal used for synchronous read operations.</input>
        <input id="wrstn">Write reset signal. Active low, defined as 0 for reset and 1 for reset signal inactive.</input>
        <input id="rrstn">Read reset signal. Active low, defined as 0 for reset and 1 for reset signal inactive.</input>
        <input id="winc">Write increment signal. Triggers write operations when active.</input>
        <input id="rinc">Read increment signal. Triggers read operations when active.</input>
        <input id="wdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Data input to be written into the FIFO.</input>
        <output id="wfull">Indicates if the FIFO is full and cannot accept further write operations.</output>
        <output id="rempty">Indicates if the FIFO is empty and cannot provide any data for read operations.</output>
